classification.difficultyReason: Successive parts identify the base diagonal, space diagonal and angle calculation.

content.prompt: The diagram shows a rectangular prism.

spec.description: Front, right and top faces visible. Hidden ordinary edges are dashed. Red BE, BH and EH identify the right triangle; the highlighted EH remains solid as a semantic construction line.
spec.mathematics: AB = 12 cm, BF = 9 cm, FG = EH = 8 cm. BE is the base projection of BH; angle EBH is α and angle BEH is right.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens and source construction triangle only.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Use Pythagoras’ theorem to find the length of the base diagonal $BE$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Hence find the length of the prism diagonal $BH$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find, correct to the nearest degree, the angle $\alpha$ that $BH$ makes with the base of the prism.
